facts.fact: The education ministry's statistical yearbook for 2024/25, drawn from its central database covering all elements of the education process, reports schools, classes, pupils, exam results and teachers.

EGY.note: No data exchange between systems is stated.

facts.fact: The ministry says its central database holding all elements of the education process is the source of the 2024/25 annual statistical yearbook.
facts.system: Central database, Ministry of Education and Technical Education

EGY.note: The yearbook is an annual census product; no daily school entry is stated.
